session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend From The Open, Then Trading Range' (13:00 axis, 12/15 with a 12/16 footer). Sell the close from the open (3980 to 3965), sell climax at 3933, pink dotted wedge rally to 3950 (08:00) that failed, nested wedge into the 3920 lows, a 20-gap bar sell with breakout test into failed-breakout-below-the-wedge lows 3912-3915 (09:50-11:45), DB PB green support, then buy the close thrust through 3935 to 3945-3948 higher highs (HH DT) sold into the 12/16 close 3925.
